To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(i) edge bundling is a useful technique to visualize and interact with coordinated relationships and (ii) a visual analytics approach is needed to explore and discover such relationships.

BiSet is a visual analytics tool to support sensemaking of coordinated relationships by visualizing them as bundles in between two lists of related entities, and users can interact with edge bundle to organize related entities and vice versa.

(1) BiSet enables interactive exploration of coordinated activities in large data sets, (2) it supports sensemaking of coordinated relationships, (3) it is a novel technique that is based on a novel model and a new visual representation, (4) it is a general technique for the exploration of coordinated activities, and (5) it is a useful tool in a real-life application.
